title: Kissed Charred Jamaican Peanut Bowl
description: A low-carb, Jamaican-inspired dish featuring charred peanuts and bonito flakes, served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the peanuts on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly charred.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the diced scotch bonnet pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked chicken among four earthenware bowls.
Top the chicken with roasted peanuts, bonito flakes, and chopped cilantro.
